content: Muwabetwe aakwenu kasa okukuwabetwa Mwemboci
Aaci no kongola mu tumelo kame tufanena okutusa nawo noku fokola oku shimba emishimbo yoo. Katufanene okuku wabetwa twemboci.
Cwale omunjili ni munjili kwaaci awabetwe woyo ayakile naye kuuwa woo, okwaa kulisa mu tumelo yoo.
Kakuli simba Kilesite kasikukuwabetwa yomboci, kono kanyi omo kung'olelwe nji, “Okwangoliwa kwaao amyangolanga kwaiya kale kwa mene.”
Eyo yonje ina kung'oliwa kunyima kame ina kung'oliwa mu mukwa no kulaela aci, nji mukoongoteta ni muku susueziwa mu liywii mbatu wana esepo.
Cwale Nyambe no kongoteta ni susuwezo amibe okuyoya wino mukaci kenu omunjili ku munjili bamweya ni Kilesite Jesu,
nji bamweya ni liywi limweya mutwese oku kanyisa Nyambe yonyene sitaye Mbumu wetu Jesu Kilesite.
Amaywi no kuwaba kwao no macaba
Abo cwale mutambule omunjili ku munjili kanyi omo ana kumitambulela Kilesite mu kanya ya Nyambe.
Abo kame nimyambela nji Kilesite nakutenda omubika kwao ana kuta ku mupato oku monisa eniti ya Nyambe, okuongoteta esepiso inakubiwa kwaa shemi oo.
Mi abo nji aano macaba akanyise Nyambe ku sishemo kumusa waye, kanyi omo kung'olelwe nji,

content.text: “Abo cwale mbani lumbeke yonyene mukaci no asimacaba,

content: Mi kame nakukwambiwa nji,
mi kame,
mi kame okutunda abo, Isaya nakwamba nji,

content.text: mi asimacaba mbaabeke esepo yoo kwayonyene.”

content: Cwale Nyambe no sepo, amiiyate okuwabelelwa mukwiyala ni kozo muku pumena kwenu, nji cwale mulibaka no mata no Mebo no kukena mwiyale esepo inene.
Elibaka lya Paulusi mukung'ola ngeeso mukuzwafa
Meene luli kame naniyupisisa kwaanyi, aabange, nji anyi kame mwiyalile ouwa ni tingana tonje mi kame mutwesa okuku laela omunjili ku munjili.
Kono banako injili kame ninaku ming'olela mukuzwafa mumukwa no kumi pulukisa, mulibaka no sishemo sinakubiwa kwa mene okutunda kwa Nyambe,
okutenda omubika wa Kilesite Jesu kwaa no macaba mu situlo nou pulisita no Liywi no kuwaba lya Nyambe, nji cwale etinubu no ao asimacaba atwese oku tambuliwa ni kenisiwa ku Mebo no kukena.
Mwa Kilesite Jesu, kame nikwite elibaka no oukukuhusa ku misebezi yange kwa Nyambe.
Kakuli kanitamba okwingena okwamba nambulwa eso anawana Kilesite mwa mene muku endisa aano macaba nji akong'elele Nyambe mulibaka lyaeyo ninaamba neyo nitenda.
Mu maata no timakazo ni yambo no kukomokisa, mu maata no Mebo nokukena, nji cwale okutunda ku Njelusalema mane ni kutunda musibaka soonje no Ililiko kame nina kutaza mukwiyala eliywi lya Kilesite.
Mane ni kwiitenda etakazo yange okukutaza eliywi oko kasikulimukiwa kale Jesu, nji cwale nilese okuyaka abo ana tateke omukwange okuyaka.
Kono kanyi omo kumg'olelwe nji,

content.text: mi mbaa yupisisa woyo kasi kwambeliwa kale eyaye.”

content: Omulelo wa Paulusi no kupotela ku Loma
Eli elibaka elyo enako yonje kame nina ku kani siwangwa okwiiya kwaanyi.
Kono bano kumona nji sikwite esibaka no kubelekela muno muti tolopo, mi ba myaka no kupula kame ninyolelwe okwiiya kwaanyi,
kame nisepile nji mbani mimono aba sanibite okuta ku Sipaini, mane nji munituse mu musipili wange kuya, munyima no oku kolwesisa oku nikong'a kwenu kanyonyo.
Kono bano kame nikatile ku Jelusalema mu musebezi waanu a Nyambe.
Kakuli asi Mesodoniya ni Akaya naawabelelwa okutundisa eyi no kuba kwaashebile mukaci kaanu a Nyambe ku Jelusalema.

Kame anakuwabelwa okutenda ngeeso mi niti luli kameli ni sikoloti kwa onyene, kakuli nji aano macaba naiyi mukukutabela kweyo no timbuyoti too no mebo, kame afanena ngeeso okwatusa mwibelekiso no timbuyoti.
Cwale abo abasa ni mane eyi mi naaba kale eyo ina litiwa, mbaniekeze okuta mu musipili wange ku Sipanishi
Mi ni limukile nji aba saniiye kwaanyi mbaniiyi meni iyalile etimbuyoti ta Kilesite.
Kame ni kumbela kwanyi aabange, mulibaka lya Mbumu wetu Jesu Kilesite mane ni mulibaka no lilato no Mebo, mu nilwele naanyi bamweya mu milapelo mulibaka lyange kwa Nyambe,
nji niikale wino kwao no kwa pumena mu Judeya mane nji omusebezi wange mu Njelusalema upumeniwe kwaanu a Nyambe.
Nji cwale mukusinga kwa Nyambe ni twese okwiiya kwanyi mukuwabelelwa nji mane niiye nitusiwe mukukuwana kwetu.
Nyambe no kozo aikale nanyi monje. Ameni
